## Summary

- Adds `content/papers/shen2026ai.md` — the first substantive reference note in `content/papers/` — for Shen & Tamkin (2026), "How AI Impacts Skill Formation" (arXiv:2601.20245).
- Includes frontmatter (title, authors, year, venue, URL, tags) and a body section rationalizing the paper's connection to the survey.
- Updates `content/papers/_meta.json` to register `shen2026ai` in the pages array.
- `bibliography.bib` already contained the correct BibTeX entry; no change needed there.

## Relevance rationale

The paper is cited multiple times in [Chapter 7 — Responsibly Deploying HCLLMs in the Workforce](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/blob/main/content/ziems2026reflections/07-applications/03-responsibly-deploying-hcllms-in-the-workforce.md) as a primary empirical anchor for the **cognitive deskilling** risk (AI delegation erodes skill acquisition) and as evidence that interaction *pattern* — not just AI presence — determines learning outcomes. It also connects to [Chapter 5 — Societal-level Evaluation](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/blob/main/content/ziems2026reflections/05-evaluation/03-societal-level-evaluation.md), where it exemplifies the randomized, longitudinal evaluation design the survey argues is necessary to measure real-world LLM impact.

Closes #11

@sepo-agent /fix-pr in our website build workflow, I want to use all giscus related repo variables -- can you add it?

**Sepo pushed fixes for this PR.** Branch: `agent/implement-issue-11/claude-27389325522`. Requested by @lolipopshock.

<!-- sepo-agent-fix-pr-status -->

- Added all 17 giscus-related environment variables (`GISCUS_ENABLED`, `GISCUS_REPO`, `GISCUS_REPO_ID`, `GISCUS_CATEGORY`, `GISCUS_CATEGORY_ID`, `GISCUS_APP_HOST`, `GISCUS_TABS`, `GISCUS_CONTENT_REPO`, `GISCUS_DEFAULT_TAB`, `GISCUS_MAPPING`, `GISCUS_STRICT`, `GISCUS_REACTIONS_ENABLED`, `GISCUS_INPUT_POSITION`, `GISCUS_LIGHT_THEME`, `GISCUS_DARK_THEME`, `GISCUS_LANG`, `GISCUS_TRIGGER_MODE`) to the **Build Quartz site** step in [`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-example-hcllms/blob/agent/implement-issue-11/claude-27389325522/.github/workflows/deploy.yml), sourced from `vars.*` repository variables.
- Pattern follows the existing `HYPOTHESIS_*` variables: `GISCUS_ENABLED` defaults to `'false'`, all others default to `''` (treated as unset by `quartz.ts`'s `envValue()` helper).
